did: I audited the whole repo, read only, for state that is answered by waiting on a promise or shown before it has been made sense of: the phone app, the shared packages and the browser extensions. I checked every main finding in the code, then filed epic 3154 with twelve stories under it. The biggest one: home's answers are made sense of in about twenty separate places, which disagree, so Jobs says pair again while My data says home can't be reached. The home link also returns one empty answer for busy, unpaired and refused alike. I also listed the readers that the pairing fix in 3152 won't reach by itself, and filed one question for you as ask 3167.

calls.title: How to file a broad audit that found more than twelve issues' worth
options: File the twelve worst, one per area, and list the rest in the epic
File every finding as its own issue
calls.why: The brief capped it near twelve, and the lower ones are small enough to fix whenever their file is touched.
calls.undo: File any listed finding from epic 3154's 'Found and not filed' section as its own issue.

calls.title: Where the pairing fix 3152 sits relative to the new epic
options: Link it from epic 3154's body and leave it under its sign-in epic 3086
Move it to be a sub-issue of 3154
calls.why: An issue has one parent, and 3152 belongs to the sign-in story that is already doing it.

left: About twenty lower-impact findings are listed in epic 3154, not filed: worth filing when their files are touched.
The speech hang in 3160 is not reproduced; nothing in the code puts a time limit on it.
